integrity: All labeled profiles through five voters are exhausted; both rules are independently implemented twice; the five-voter count is independently recovered from anonymous profiles; all conflicts are canonicalized under candidate and voter relabeling.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for three candidates and electorates through five voters; the sharp boundary concerns different unique winners, not all set-valued disagreements. The older 2002 article has no exact public day asserted here.
title: Sharp five-voter unique-winner conflict layer for Borda and Copeland
